Data Engineering Stack

This is what a complete data engineering stack actually looks like.

Most people learn tools in isolation…
but real-world engineering is about how everything connects.

This visual breaks down the full data journey - from raw data to business decisions 👇

→ Data Sources: Databases, APIs, SaaS tools feeding raw data
→ Ingestion: Airbyte, Fivetran, Kafka bringing data into the system
→ Storage: S3, BigQuery, Snowflake acting as your data foundation
→ Processing: Spark, dbt, Airflow transforming raw data into usable formats
→ Querying: SQL tools to explore and extract insights
→ Analysis: Python, R, Excel turning data into understanding
→ Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Looker telling the story
→ Governance: Data quality, cataloging, and trust layers
→ Machine Learning: Predictive models and advanced analytics
→ Real-Time: Streaming systems for instant insights
→ Orchestration: Managing workflows and pipelines
→ Monitoring: Ensuring everything runs reliably

The key shift?

Don’t focus on mastering one tool.
Focus on understanding the flow.

Because tools will change.
But the architecture behind them stays the same.

Save this - it’s your blueprint for becoming a complete data professional.
